actual_task_instruction: Import markdown notes in the "~/documents/personal/notes/" directory of my file system to my Simple Note account. Each markdown file should become a separate note in the Simple Note account. The title of each note should be taken from the name of the source file (excluding the directory path and file extension), replacing underscores in it with blank spaces.

packet_source.instruction: Import markdown notes in the "~/documents/personal/notes/" directory of my file system to my Simple Note account. agents.actual_task_instruction: Import markdown notes in the "~/documents/personal/notes/" directory of my file system to my Simple Note account. Each markdown file should become a separate note in the Simple Note account. The title of each note should be taken from the name of the source file (excluding the directory path and file extension), replacing underscores in it with blank spaces.
released_registered_requirements:
obtain added, updated, removed simple_note.Note records using models.changed_records,
and assert 0 were updated or removed.

assert the added notes' titles match keys of
data.private.note_title_to_content (ignore_order, ignore_case, strip).

assert the added notes' contents match values of data.private.note_title_to_content
(ignore_order, ignore_case).

assert the added notes' title to content mapping match
keys of data.private.note_title_to_content (ignore_case, strip)
